findings.summary: A script patch's number counts only its library's script-built patches, so dropping port patches no longer renumbers the SDL script files: the trimmed-only patches are 0001-static-no-dynapi and 0002-no-joystick-device-names, and retiring sdl-multisample-read at 3.4.18 will not rename them again.

upstream.state keeps meaning this repository's submission; a new optional `related` field links upstream threads others opened (SDL #16369, PR #15170, draft PR #15651, RmlUi PR #962), and those four patches stay unsubmitted.
Delete build-options assertions on the trimmed patch's number and location, which patches:check already enforces.
The package-notices fixture reads the SDL version from the overlay port instead of a stale 3.4.14 literal.
The TODO row points at the manifest's retire field instead of restating it, and audit.md names the trimmed patch by slug.
Drop the default port-version line, strip the stale index line of d3d12-storage-array.patch, and update the pal_sdl_gpu.cpp comment to SDL 3.4.18.
Derive the trimmed SDL series in test/patch-inventory.test.ts from the manifest instead of a hand-kept tail and count.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: the hand-kept list is a golden check of patch-identity.cmake's variant selection; deriving it from the manifest in TypeScript would re-implement that selection and stop checking it.
